name: Baro
source:
Gravekeeper of the Dark Church.
His whole body is covered in bandages, even his face is hidden, apparently his unhidden face is super beautiful.
He likes small, gloomy spaces and is not very good at dealing with people.
He's a horror enthusiast, but whenever he listens to scary stories he gets so scared he can't go to the bathroom alone.
Despite his proficiency at digging holes he has a weak constitution, and because he gets anemia whenever the sunlight hits him, he often sleeps during the day.
